description: 艺术动画skill：35种艺术风格、9种解说语法，用代码让画动起来。
summary: I like that huashu-art-motion treats art animation as a code-generation problem with a real QA loop: you feed it a style recipe card and a grammar spec, it renders through Playwright, then `qa.py` measures fluency and motion density, `film_gate.py` rejects anything that reads as a slideshow, and a second agent that wasn't in the production room watches the final cut for issues. The skill format (`npx skills add`) and the recipe/grammar card structure make it drop into an agent session the same way PenguPool routes one, which is the composable, local-first pattern I care about. What sold me most is `breakdown.py`: it reverse-engineers a reference clip into a beat grid and per-segment motion heatmap before you write a single frame, which is the kind of toil-removing engineering I respect far more than another "AI video generator" wrapper.
